text:
jessica: quick review — ArborCloud sent final logos and a short partner credential for the marketplace tile. Legal flagged the credential as a potential customer claim. Need alt-text for the hero logo and an approved credential line by 4pm PT. attaching draft.
matt: can you paste the credential draft here so we can comment inline? :eyes:
jessica: sure — draft they sent:
```
ArborCloud — enterprise-grade hybrid cloud platform powering low-latency model serving across private and public clouds.
```
elaine: design/ax note — alt-text for the main logo should be short and descriptive. suggestion:

`ArborCloud logo: stylized tree with cloud outline, green-blue gradient` 

Also please send the vector so we can export 2:1 and 1:1 badge crops for the marketplace.
samir: marketing POV — the draft sounds fine but "powering" could be interpreted as a quantified claim. prefer shorter credential for the tile, e.g.: 

`ArborCloud — hybrid orchestration for secure, low-latency model serving`
katie: legal — prefer to avoid words that imply measurable reach (# of customers, uptime claims) unless there is an audit. "Powering" is borderline. The samir rewording is much safer. A tiny tweak to remove superlatives would be:

`ArborCloud — hybrid orchestration for secure, low-latency model serving` 

approved for marketplace copy. Please do not include "enterprise-grade" or "powering".
marco: accessibility quick check — for alt-text keep it under ~125 chars and avoid saying "logo of". elaine's alt-text looks fine; my only ask is include color in the asset metadata, not alt text. Also cc'ing design system for badge spacing rules.
jessica: perfect — updating assets: will replace credential with the approved line and swap alt-text to elaine's suggestion in the manifest. pushing updated SVGs and 1:1 PNG badges to the shared drive: https://files.redwood.ai/partners/arborcloud/v1/
matt: thanks — I'll add a quick QA step to the marketplace checklist to confirm alt-text + badge aspect ratios before publish.
katie: noted. legal signs off on the final copy for the listing. please keep a copy of their original draft in the contract folder for provenance. :white_check_mark:
jessica: thanks everyone! will publish to the staging marketplace by 3:30pm PT and aim for production after QA. :rocket:
